purpose: Demand signals scored by acquisition/lib/signal-score.mjs. Every dimension carries an explicit evidence class. OBSERVED means it was read from a measurement, a repository record or an external primary/public record. ASSUMPTION and HYPOTHESIS are NOT evidence and must never be reported as such.

signals.title: Public agent scheduling activity exposes unattended-control questions
signals.user_problem: Teams building schedulers for AI agents need a way to check permissions, human approval boundaries, retry ceilings and cost controls before unattended execution becomes routine.
observed_basis: Hacker News official public API returned Show HN: Moadim.io – A scheduler for agents (item 49571537) in the verified External Nervous System run
the item had score 36 and 18 comments in the captured evidence; this proves discussion/activity, not purchase intent
the external sensor classified the item HIGH for multi-agent governance but explicitly recorded purchase intent as unproven

pain_intensity.note: the post proves active building and discussion; it does not itself say buyers are suffering this exact governance pain

urgency.note: no deadline or buying window was observed

audience_fit.note: agent builders are adjacent to the engineering/founder audience, but individual buyer identity was not established

commercial_intent.note: no checkout, contract, budget or buyer request was observed

asset_fit.note: the verified inventory already contains Agent Control Auditor and paid agent-governance assets with matching problem keys

content_fit.note: a bounded educational entry around unattended-agent controls fits the observed topic but has not yet produced qualified traffic from this source

distribution_fit.note: an Agent Control Auditor publisher exists, but its historic queue and currently verified social accounts need alignment before this can be treated as an autonomous placement lane

measurement_quality.note: Agent Control Auditor records funnel_view, qualified_tool_action, paid_offer_exposure, primary_cta_click and checkout_click; purchase still requires payment-provider evidence

safety.note: the intended entry is an owned free diagnostic; no HN auto-commenting or unsolicited contact is permitted by this route
